_about: OpenStreetMap geometry for the Parc Güell landmarks (build-parc-guell-landmarks.py). Each entry: `centroid` [lat, lon] is the model origin (vertex mean of the outer ring, closing vertex dropped; for a point landmark, the OSM node). ringEN_m / members[].pathEN_m / pointEN_m are metres, +X east, +Y north, relative to that entry's centroid (equirectangular, R=6378137, cos(lat) of the centroid). `ensemble` lists mapped features the model also stands in for; `context` is every mapped thing within the radius, for reference only. `anchorOnly`: the featureId only tells the app the landmark is in view; that feature is NOT replaced. Data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Fetched 2026-09-24.

sala-hipostila.name: Sala Hipòstila and Plaça de la Natura, with the serpentine bench

pavello-consergeria.name: Pavelló de Consergeria (the entrance pavilion paired with the Casa del Guarda; verify which context footprint it is)

turo-tres-creus.name: Turó de les Tres Creus (the Calvary)
turo-tres-creus.note: A point on the park: featureId is the park itself; the park is NOT replaced.

portic-bugadera.name: Pòrtic de la Bugadera (the leaning-column portico)
portic-bugadera.note: A point on the park. Align the portico with the mapped footway passing the node (see context).
